start.speaker: system
start.text: ARCHIVE INDEX — CINDER WAKE HOLD. RESTRICTED: COMMAND AND CUSTODIAN ONLY.

choices.text: Tav-7, can you talk to it?
Read the physical labels on the cylinders instead.

locked.speaker: system
locked.text: ACCESS DENIED. This console locks out for the session. The cylinders themselves have printed labels.

locked_tav.speaker: tav7
locked_tav.text: It does not want to talk to me. It knows I refused normalization. Perhaps another way.

labels.speaker: narrator
labels.text: Each cylinder carries a strip label: an index number, a camp code — VESPER, CALLAN — and a name. Hundreds of names. The label on the nearest one reads 0441 DARROW, E.

opened_cred.speaker: warden
opened_cred.text: CUSTODIAN ACCESS. INDEX UNSEALED. You do not need to ask, Source. Everything here is yours to see.

opened.speaker: system
opened.text: INDEX OPEN. 3,112 records. Program: DIRECTIVE 9 — PATTERN HARVEST.

choices.text: Copy engram 0441 to a data spike.

harvest.speaker: system
harvest.text: DIRECTIVE 9. Engrams archived: 3,112. Source: Haldis detainees. Consent: not required (security exemption). Purpose: operator training substrate; custodian template validation.

harvest_tav.speaker: tav7
harvest_tav.text: 'Consent: not required.' Three thousand people, and the field for their consent says not required.

harvest_iona.speaker: iona
harvest_iona.text: And we were told it was medical archive cores. I signed the cargo manifest.

vesper.speaker: system
vesper.text: ENGRAM 0441 — DARROW, ESHE, CORPORAL, CONCORD GARRISON, VESPER STATION. Playback: forty minutes.

vesper2.speaker: narrator
vesper2.text: You only let it run for a minute. It is enough: the singing at the gate, the cold attention settling behind Darrow's eyes, her hands rising without her. You know that attention. You were taught how to be it.

choices.text: (Let the rest play. Someone should witness all of it.)

effects.reason: Witnessed the Vesper testimony in full

witness.speaker: narrator
witness.text: Forty minutes. When it ends, your hands are steady and your face is wet.

copy.speaker: system
copy.text: ENGRAM 0441 COPIED TO DATA SPIKE. Original retained.

custodian.speaker: system
custodian.text: CUSTODIAN TEMPLATE — SOURCE RECORD SEALED. AUTHORITY: COMMAND. NOTE: CUSTODIAN PRESENT ABOARD.

cust_known.speaker: warden
cust_known.text: Present. Present. Present. You are standing at the index, Source.
